name: Summer Blockbusters
subject: Big movies
tagline: Twenty questions from the shark that started it all to the films that broke the box office. Starts easy, ends hard.

questions.q: Which 1975 film about a great white shark is usually called the first summer blockbuster?
questions.w: Steven Spielberg's Jaws opened in June 1975 on hundreds of screens at once, backed by television adverts, and became the first film to pass $100 million at the US box office.

questions.q: In Jurassic Park, the dinosaurs are cloned from DNA taken from what?
questions.w: The park's scientists extract dinosaur blood from mosquitoes preserved in amber and patch the gaps with frog DNA, which is how the dinosaurs end up breeding.

questions.q: Who played Jack Dawson in Titanic?
questions.w: DiCaprio was 22 when Titanic was made. Kate Winslet played Rose, and the film won 11 Academy Awards.

questions.q: Independence Day builds to its final battle on which US holiday?
questions.w: The aliens arrive on July 2, destroy the cities on July 3, and the counterattack comes on July 4, which gives Bill Pullman's president his speech.

questions.q: Which 2008 film introduced Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark and started the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.w: Iron Man opened in May 2008. The Incredible Hulk followed a month later, and the post-credits scene with Nick Fury set up the whole shared universe.

questions.q: What kind of car is the time machine in Back to the Future?
questions.w: Doc Brown builds it into a DeLorean DMC-12 with gull-wing doors. Early drafts of the script had the time machine as a refrigerator.

questions.q: True or false: Avatar was directed by James Cameron.
questions.w: True. Cameron wrote and directed Avatar, released in 2009, and it became the highest-grossing film ever made.

questions.q: Which 1989 film put Michael Keaton in the cowl and Jack Nicholson in the Joker's make-up?
questions.w: Tim Burton's Batman was the big film of summer 1989. Nicholson's deal gave him a share of the profits, reportedly earning him more than $50 million.

questions.q: In The Matrix, which pill does Neo take to learn the truth?
questions.w: Morpheus offers blue to forget and red to see how deep the rabbit hole goes. Neo takes the red pill.

questions.q: In Top Gun, Maverick flies which fighter jet?
questions.w: The 1986 film used real US Navy F-14 Tomcats. The 2022 sequel moved Maverick into the F/A-18 Super Hornet.

questions.q: Which 1996 film had Helen Hunt and Bill Paxton chasing tornadoes across Oklahoma?
questions.w: Twister was the second-highest-grossing film of 1996 and was the first feature film released on DVD in the United States.

questions.q: Select every film that Steven Spielberg directed.
questions.w: Spielberg directed E.T., Raiders and Jurassic Park. Ghostbusters was directed by Ivan Reitman.

questions.q: In Men in Black, who played Agent K opposite Will Smith?
questions.w: Tommy Lee Jones played the deadpan Agent K to Smith's Agent J. The film was the third-biggest of 1997 behind Titanic and The Lost World.

questions.q: Which film was the first in the Harry Potter series?
o: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
questions.w: It arrived in November 2001, retitled Sorcerer's Stone in the United States, and was the highest-grossing film of that year.

questions.q: Put these films in order of release, earliest first.
questions.w: Jaws came in 1975, Star Wars in 1977, Raiders of the Lost Ark in 1981 and Ghostbusters in 1984.

questions.q: Which 1982 film about a hunter of replicants flopped on release and was later reclaimed as a classic?
questions.w: Ridley Scott's Blade Runner opened two weeks after E.T. and struggled. Its reputation grew on video, and a director's cut followed in 1992.

questions.q: In Terminator 2, what is the model number of the liquid-metal Terminator?
questions.w: Robert Patrick's shape-shifting T-1000 hunts John Connor while Arnold Schwarzenegger's T-800 protects him.

questions.q: Which film was the highest-grossing film of all time worldwide from 1998 until 2010?
o: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
questions.w: Titanic held the record for about twelve years until Avatar overtook it in January 2010. Both were directed by James Cameron.

questions.q: In Speed, the bus will explode if its speed drops below what?
questions.w: Dennis Hopper's bomber sets the trigger at 50 miles per hour. Keanu Reeves and Sandra Bullock keep the bus above it through Los Angeles traffic.

questions.q: Which 1998 asteroid film, with Bruce Willis and an Aerosmith theme song, was the highest-grossing film of its year worldwide?
questions.w: Armageddon took about $553 million worldwide, ahead of Saving Private Ryan. Deep Impact, the other asteroid film of 1998, came out two months earlier.
